coverage.description: The integrity gate is authoritative for every subject listed in governance/traceability.json. Project-wide backfill is tracked separately and expands this set.

decisions.title: Adopt decision provenance and traceability governance
decisions.summary: Approved game decisions must be recorded with immutable IDs, explicit supersession, canonical source paths, implementation status, and release-surface traceability. Conflicts require quarantine rather than interpretation.

decisions.title: Pathfinders Action targets a Territory, not an Arena
decisions.summary: Pathfinders Action may choose one Territory. Arena targets are not legal.

decisions.title: Assimilation uses a banked Asset and qualifying aftermath trigger
decisions.summary: Assimilation Action is a banked Asset used optionally after a qualifying attacking win. It is not a temporary Condition and is not consumed on a loss.

decisions.title: Invasion modifies initial Battle Hand formation
decisions.summary: An attacking Invasion Battle effect draws one additional card when forming the initial Battle Hand and permits one additional choice. It does not open a post-reveal draw window.

decisions.title: Armistice is a persistent Asset with post-draw upkeep
decisions.summary: Armistice Action remains banked while its controller pays the required two-card upkeep after the normal Draw step. It has no turn-based expiry and cannot be voluntarily discarded at another time.

decisions.title: Decoys prevents an Asset from leaving play
decisions.summary: Decoys is a replacement effect. The protected Asset remains in play and must not leave play and then be recreated.

decisions.title: Quarantine incomplete Arcane Knowledge Battle replay
decisions.summary: Arcane Knowledge Battle play remains unavailable until the engine can resolve every eligible Battle effect at its correct timing instead of relying on an incomplete allowlist.

decisions.title: Rename Neutral Siege Weaponry to Bombardment
decisions.summary: The current Neutral card is Bombardment, cost 4. Siege Weaponry is reserved as a possible future Engineer card and may appear only in historical records or explicitly declared legacy migration code.

decisions.title: Manifest Destiny remains approved but not implemented
decisions.summary: Manifest Destiny is canonical and Unique, but must remain unavailable digitally until its dynamic Territory insertion and cleanup behavior pass the governance merge gate.
